en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's study
I'm getting sleepy...
Sure is dusty in here
Huh?

Moi, study? The fuck do I need to study for!?
My genius brain's not defective like yours!

Are you the kinda gross fuckhead who thinks
piss and cornflakes taste good together!?
Are you saying...

you wanna sleep with me...?
Is that what you mean...?
D-D-D-D-Don't get cocky all of a sudden...

Geez, I'm so nervous...
How am I supposed to sleep now!?

Huh? No shit it's dusty! Got any other
brilliant insights, Captain Obvious!?

Tell me, do you also look down at your dick
and say, "Wow! Look how small you are!"

Maybe you should do some research on how
to make your string bean a beanstalk!
<CLT=cltMIND>...Why are you yelling at me?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
(Hmph...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Miu's inner thoughts...?
